name: IPC sells burn the pair's balance
summary: The IPC token burns a pending destroyNum of IPC straight out of its PancakeSwap pair and calls sync() on every sell, and each sell adds half its size to destroyNum. Inside flash loans the attacker repeatedly flash-swapped IPC out of the pair and sold it back, so each round burned pair-held IPC and lifted the price, then sold into the inflated USDT reserve.
notes: Later owner actions (setPool, renouncing ownership) and opening trading do not touch the burn logic; the pair's creation is not a change to the token, so the deployment is the reset.
The pair was drained in this single transaction; an attempt seconds earlier reverted. The sender paid a builder bribe; no earlier exercise of the burn appears in the pair's history.
